_doc: Stream E (M2). Text pools for signs of other players (PLAN §5.4). The server (A) records the trace; the client (D) fills a template picked by a seeded hash of the trace id (so every client shows the SAME line for the same grave). Placeholders: {name} character name, {level}, {class} class name, {killer} what killed them (monster/encounter display name), {party} leader name + "'s party" or just the name when solo, {ago} 'a minute ago' / '4 minutes ago' (client formats from the timestamp), {place} dungeon / fort / site name, {count}, {zone} zone name, {what} thing counted. Lines are plain language, no banned names. `fadeMinutes` = how long the trace lasts; `max` = how many of that kind a zone copy keeps (oldest drops first).

title: Here fell {name}
{name}'s grave
A fresh mound: {name}
lines: Someone has scratched '{name} — {killer} — {ago}' on a flat stone.
A dented helmet on a stick. {name}, level {level}, fell to {killer} {ago}.
elite: {name}, level {level}, fought {killer} and lost. Most do. {ago}.
{name} stood against {killer} here. The ground keeps the mark, for an hour.
fall: {name} found out how high this was. {ago}.
drown: {name} could not swim as far as they hoped. {ago}.

lines: A campfire, still warm. {name} sat here {ago}.
Someone's fire. {name} left a pot and most of a sausage.
Warm coals and a bedroll shape in the grass. {name} rested here {ago}.
{party} camped here {ago}. They left the fire going, which is rude, but warm.
Ashes, still glowing. A note in the dirt: '{name} was here'.
campfire.restBuff: Sitting by a player's fire gives the same out-of-combat regeneration as your own.

dungeon: A banner on the door of {place}: '{party} went in. {party} came out.' {ago}.
{party} cleared {place} {ago}. The boss is having a lie-down.
Fresh paint on {place}: '{party} — {ago} — all of us came back'.
fort: {party} took back {place} {ago}. The quartermaster is still counting arrows.
event: The marks of a big fight. {place} ended {ago}; {count} fought.
worldboss: The ground is churned for a hundred metres. {killer} fell here {ago}, to {count} of them.

deeds._doc: The zone deed feed on the map (one line per counter, last 60 minutes). {count} >= 1; the client hides a counter at 0.

{count} zone events won here this hour.

footprints._doc: No text: a path decal where many players walked (A counts steps per 8 m cell per hour; D draws a worn path above `minStepsPerHour`).
